desc:
BETTY CROCKER, REESE'S AND HERSHEY'S: Betty Crocker Baking Mix made with REESE'S Peanut Butter chips and HERSHEY'S Milk Chocolate chips

CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER COMBO: Warm, rich chocolate meets melty peanut butter in every batch of oven baked muffins made with this Betty Crocker REESE'S Peanut Butter Muffin Mix

CONVENIENT AND EASY: Just stir ingredients together, fill muffin cups, and bake according to the easy package directions to have irresistible peanut butter muffins the whole family can enjoy

SPECIAL OCCASION TREATS: Serve baked muffins as sweets for celebrations and everyday moments; Ideal for office treats, birthday parties, baked goods gift baskets, and more

CONTAINS: Betty Crocker REESE'S Peanut Butter Muffin Mix, with REESE’S Peanut Butter Chips, 12.8 oz
features:
Features

REESE’S Peanut Butter Flavor

Infused with real Reese’s peanut butter chips for an authentic, rich peanut butter taste in every bite.

Lava Cake Format

Bakes into a gooey, molten-centered chocolate cake with a peanut butter twist—like a dessert from a fancy restaurant.

asy to Prepare

Just add butter and eggs. No need for extra ingredients, fancy tools, or measuring. Simple stir-and-bake method.

Includes Foil Baking Cups

Comes with 8 single-serve foil cups, making portioning easy and cleanup even easier.

Betty Crocker Quality

Known for reliable and consistent baking results—moist texture, balanced sweetness, and foolproof instructions.

Ready in Minutes

Great for last-minute dessert cravings or unexpected guests—bakes quickly in a home oven.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Mini REESE'S Peanut Butter Chips (partially defatted peanuts, sugar, hydrogenated vegetable oil [palm kernel, soybean], corn syrup solids, dextrose, reduced protein whey, salt, palm kernel oil, artificial flavor, soy lecithin), HERSHEY'S Milk Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate, skim milk, cocoa butter, milk fat, soy lecithin, natural flavor), REESE'S Peanut Butter (peanuts, sugar, monoglycerides, peanut oil, salt, molasses, corn starch), Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate), Contains 2% or less of: Modified Corn Starch, Salt, Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Corn Starch, Mono and Diglycerides, Color Added, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Artificial Flavor.
